notes: The list is essentially complete: both concertos, the Sonata Op. 134, Tsyganov's 19 Op. 34 prelude arrangements (Nos. 1–3, 5, 6, 8, 10–13 and 15–24 except 14 and 23, which matches the published Tsyganov set), the Op. 5 dances (set and Heifetz Waltz), the Gadfly Romance, and the Atovmyan duets and album pieces. Possible remaining candidates, such as completions of the other five preludes, further Gadfly or ballet excerpts, or a Polka from The Age of Gold, are left out because I cannot confirm an established violinist's arrangement and a named edition; the 1945 sonata fragment is excluded as a fragment.
